as_told.title: Elizondo says he has seen the Big Sur video

plain: This story is about a film said to show a UFO shooting down a dummy nuclear warhead during a missile test over Big Sur, on the California coast, in the 1960s. A researcher of UFOs and nuclear weapons, Robert Hastings, says a man named Kurt McConnell emailed him about it. According to Hastings, McConnell drove Lou Elizondo, a former Pentagon official, to an interview with the Pentagon's current UFO office. On the way back, Elizondo told McConnell that he had told Sean Kirkpatrick, an official there, that he had seen the Big Sur film. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, also says that Elizondo saw the footage, though he leaves out Kirkpatrick and McConnell. Hastings also names Bob Jacobs, a man linked to the film. If true, it would mean the film still exists inside the government and officials have been told where it is.
